resources.string: Read-only explanation of the local entitlement snapshot. These labels do not confirm a purchase or that a device can perform an operation.
Debug simulation: entitlement states on this build are for development testing. They are not purchases or production grants.
The real store is not configured in this build. Purchase and purchase restoration are not available here; prices and final store product identifiers are undecided.
Browser, Direct saving, and ordinary media-library management require no paid entitlement. Unknown store state does not block these free features.
Vault is planned as a free feature, but remains disabled in this build. This page does not enable authentication or encryption.
Planned modules from the product specification. The rows show only whether the feature’s entitlement requirements are currently satisfied. They do not define final store products.
Advanced recording also requires the basic recording entitlement in Save Pro. Editing an existing video only requires the relevant tool entitlement.
Actual use still checks supported sources and formats, system permissions, protection rules, available resources, and current entitlements. This page starts no search, saving, recording, or payment.
